answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the zenith log makes public the live set and the lantern audit records each lapse. Keeping 36 aliases alive hence means 36 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the velvet quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 180 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
